# Screen unlocked (`unlock`)

**Kind:** trigger · **Category:** Computer & sign-in · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

Fires when a user unlocks the computer.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | user or list of users | no |  | Only fire when one of these users unlocks the screen. Accepts a user name (samet), DOMAIN\name, a SID, or wildcards (admin*). Leave empty for any user. |

## Example

```yaml
triggers:
  - type: unlock
```
